answer: Require a steady pulse of verified work: each identity earns only while it keeps completing useful tasks at a regular cadence, and rewards vest gradually over many epochs. A gale of freshly minted identities earns nothing on day one, since a burst of registrations carries no work history; an attacker must fund and run every fake identity for months to mimic one honest agent, while each honest agent's long record stands as a relic of real effort that cannot be bought in bulk.
